suite.title: Nicelydrapped capability models
suite.description: Observed TUI behavior and source-grounded target workflows for shared TUI and web product design.
suite.generatedFrom: Nicelydrapped specifications and the 2026-08-27 observed capability suite

01-current-tui-startup-navigation.bpmn.title: TUI startup and navigation
01-current-tui-startup-navigation.bpmn.summary: What a user can currently do from launch through workspace discovery, browsing, filtering, search, inspection, and exit.
01-current-tui-startup-navigation.bpmn.implementationStatus: Observed directly and supported by executable demonstrations.
01-current-tui-startup-navigation.bpmn.tuiDesign: Preserve asynchronous startup feedback, exact focus, contextual actions, and deterministic return state.
01-current-tui-startup-navigation.bpmn.webDesign: Translate the same qualified navigation into accessible list/detail routes without copying domain decisions into the browser.

02-current-tui-edit-save.bpmn.title: TUI editing and save safety
02-current-tui-edit-save.bpmn.summary: The current typed editing loop, including cancel, validation, guarded deletion, dirty state, saving, export, and failure retention.
02-current-tui-edit-save.bpmn.implementationStatus: Observed for controlled-choice editing and broadly covered by shipped tests and demonstrations.
02-current-tui-edit-save.bpmn.tuiDesign: Keep edits contextual and keyboard-operable; never mutate on cancel or discard pending work after a failed save.
02-current-tui-edit-save.bpmn.webDesign: Use accessible typed controls and the same application-owned mutation and persistence result contracts.

03-target-shared-document-lifecycle.bpmn.title: Shared document lifecycle
03-target-shared-document-lifecycle.bpmn.summary: The channel-neutral lifecycle both TUI and web should use to prepare, expose, degrade, recover, and release a document context.
03-target-shared-document-lifecycle.bpmn.implementationStatus: Backend preparation exists; shared reader/release behavior and frontend adoption remain incomplete.
03-target-shared-document-lifecycle.bpmn.tuiDesign: Drive long-running work through commands and explicit result states rather than hidden constructor I/O.
03-target-shared-document-lifecycle.bpmn.webDesign: Represent lifecycle outcomes as accessible route states while keeping parsing, identity, validation, and policy in shared application services.

04-target-evidence-to-conclusion.bpmn.title: Evidence to conclusion
04-target-evidence-to-conclusion.bpmn.summary: An evidence-first research flow that keeps source material, extraction, reasoning, and conclusions distinct and reviewable.
04-target-evidence-to-conclusion.bpmn.implementationStatus: Core STEMMA target; individual authoring surfaces exist but the end-to-end shared workflow is partial.
04-target-evidence-to-conclusion.bpmn.tuiDesign: Provide dedicated source/evidence actions and an explicit trail back from conclusions.
04-target-evidence-to-conclusion.bpmn.webDesign: Use a reviewable evidence workspace powered by shared use cases and scoped identity.

05-target-entity-link-authoring.bpmn.title: Entity and link authoring
05-target-entity-link-authoring.bpmn.summary: Strict authoring across entities, support roots, containers, collections, keys, and typed links.
05-target-entity-link-authoring.bpmn.implementationStatus: Most TUI surfaces exist; shared channel-neutral mutation orchestration remains partial.
05-target-entity-link-authoring.bpmn.tuiDesign: Use contextual editors and pickers with explicit Dataset scope, validation paths, and impact confirmation.
05-target-entity-link-authoring.bpmn.webDesign: Use accessible forms and searchable pickers backed by the same typed operations.

06-target-narrative-transcription.bpmn.title: Narrative and transcription
06-target-narrative-transcription.bpmn.summary: Rich transcription and authored narrative with reusable Text, semantic markup, references, preview, and safe cancellation.
06-target-narrative-transcription.bpmn.implementationStatus: Basic editing and strict Text support exist; advanced narrative interaction is incomplete.
06-target-narrative-transcription.bpmn.tuiDesign: Treat this as the intentional major non-two-pane mode with explicit source, preview, and diff views.
06-target-narrative-transcription.bpmn.webDesign: Provide a structured, accessible editor without flattening STEMMA mixed content into plain notes.

07-target-search-evidence-resource-trail.title: Search and evidence trail
07-target-search-evidence-resource-trail.summary: Qualified search and semantic navigation that preserve origin, expose evidence trails, resolve resource access, and return exactly.
07-target-search-evidence-resource-trail.implementationStatus: Search and screen restoration exist; durable derivation edges and safe resource handoff do not.
07-target-search-evidence-resource-trail.tuiDesign: Keep filter, plain search, guided search, and semantic links distinct, with exact back-stack restoration.
07-target-search-evidence-resource-trail.webDesign: Use stable deep links and origin tokens rather than relying on browser history as the semantic trail.

08-target-validation-persistence-interch.title: Validation, persistence, and interchange
08-target-validation-persistence-interch.summary: A failure-safe path from validation through save, Save As, XML export, verified reopen, recovery, and packaging.
08-target-validation-persistence-interch.implementationStatus: Layered validation and atomic writes exist; stale-baseline, durable backup, verified reopen, and packaging are incomplete.
08-target-validation-persistence-interch.tuiDesign: Navigate to exact findings and keep dirty/pending state whenever persistence cannot be proven successful.
08-target-validation-persistence-interch.webDesign: Expose draft, conflict, export, and recovery states through the same application result envelope.

09-target-tui-experience.bpmn.title: Target TUI experience
09-target-tui-experience.bpmn.summary: How the terminal experience should orchestrate shared workflows through deterministic Bubble Tea states and contextual keyboard actions.
09-target-tui-experience.bpmn.implementationStatus: Mixed completion across the current two-pane shell and planned shared application seams.
09-target-tui-experience.bpmn.tuiDesign: Make focus, mode, available actions, long-running work, validation, and recovery visible and deterministic.
09-target-tui-experience.bpmn.webDesign: Not a web interaction blueprint; use it to identify shared workflow boundaries, not to copy terminal mechanics.

10-target-web-experience.bpmn.title: Target web experience
10-target-web-experience.bpmn.summary: A responsive and accessible web adapter over shared lifecycle, reader, mutation, validation, and persistence workflows.
10-target-web-experience.bpmn.implementationStatus: Design contract only; no web adapter currently exists in Nicelydrapped.
10-target-web-experience.bpmn.tuiDesign: Use this model to protect shared application ownership while allowing presentation-appropriate terminal interactions.
10-target-web-experience.bpmn.webDesign: Use semantic HTML, responsive list/detail layouts, stable deep links, keyboard support, and accessible validation summaries.
